# Cryostrata lar

**Status: DRAFT** · world: [icemoon](../lore/worlds/icemoon.md) · kind: new · stage: space · id: `cryostrata_lar`

## Niche

- **Habitat:** 2–10 m below ice shell (polar & equatorial zones)
- **Diet:** Chemoautotrophic biofilms & radiolytic precipitates
- **Active:** Continuous, peaks during tidal flexure & ice-quakes
- **Predators:** Thermarctus ferox

## Body

Flat disc with ciliary fringes, ventral rasping mouth, dorsal crystalline plates

**Temperament:** Docile, solitary, highly vigilant to pressure waves

### cryostrata_lar.c1: Ventral rasping mouth and flattened disc shape

  3. Biofilm trail left behind
